candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record reveals that after cemiplimab treatment, residual papular lesions showed dermoscopic features typical of basal cell carcinoma, and the initial biopsy noted lobules of eosinophilic keratinocytes without clear basaloid nests — yet the overall picture (mixed SCC and BCC features in the same lesion) points to basosquamous carcinoma. C001 captures only the squamous cell carcinoma component and the partial metabolic response state, missing the defining basaloid/BCC component required for the composite diagnosis of basosquamous carcinoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the squamous component and treatment response state but omits the basaloid/basal cell carcinoma component that defines basosquamous carcinoma

case_quality_flags: Initial biopsy diagnosis of pure SCC may have undersampled the basaloid component, consistent with basosquamous carcinoma being underdiagnosed on initial pathology
Dermoscopic BCC features in residual lesions post-cemiplimab support the basosquamous composite diagnosis as the reference
